title: The Dying Gipsy
author: James Crabb

authorInfo.bio: James Crabb (1774–1851) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
works: The Gipsies' Advocate Or, Observations on the Origin, Character, Manners, and Habits of the English Gipsies

description: "The Dying Gipsy" by James Crabb is a religious narrative written in the 19th century. This work presents a poignant account focused on themes of sin, conscience, and redemption, as it follows the final moments of a dying gipsy named Stanley.
